comment: Real exceptions to scripts/check-no-internal-refs.mjs. One entry per {file, match}; the reason says why the string has to stay. An entry that stops matching fails the check, so this list can shrink and never silently grow.

entries.reason: Directory name an earlier release parked the legacy JSON stores in. Existing projects still hold their files there, so the reader must keep looking in it. Never written.
Edge rule id earlier releases wrote into edges.evidence. The re-derive purge must still match it or old table edges would be duplicated. Never written.
Meta key an earlier release stamped the record schema with. Opening such a graph must recognise it, and the migration deletes it. Never written.
Name of the extraction manifest earlier releases wrote into analysis/. Existing projects hold it and it must stay classed as the tool's manifest. Never written.
Artifact role earlier releases registered the extraction manifest under. Existing project records carry it and the importer must still accept it. Never written.
Glob for the extraction manifest name earlier releases wrote, so it is still registered. Never written.
Hidden idempotency token earlier releases put into steering.md. Without recognising it the block would be appended a second time. Never written.

Default disk ID of a built D64: the two ASCII characters S and 1 in the header. Not a slot id.
Value earlier releases stamped into meta.cart_grammar. A graph carrying it counts as stamped, and the producer-id migration rewrites it. Never written.
The numeric producer id earlier releases wrote for memory access. This CommonJS reader opens graph.sqlite on its own and may meet a file the renaming has not reached yet. Never written.
